scoring.numeric_stats: 1-5 ordinal game translations; not Brix, acidity measurements, or cultivar rankings
scoring.weighted_fit: For each trait use max(0, 1 - distance_from_target_range/4), weighted mean; >=0.88 gives 3, >=0.65 gives 2, >=0.40 gives 1, otherwise 0. Explicit brief constraints and documented-use overrides then apply.
scoring.default_unknown: Neutral 3/5 game prior, unknown factual trait retained; cooked shape unknown caps whole/piece cooking ratings at 2 unless documented use overrides.
scoring.technique_bonus: 0 or +1 for assisted or skilled execution; available during onboarding so starter Fuji pie can earn 3.
scoring.recipe_adaptation_delta: 0 or +1 after an explicit valid recipe adjustment such as lemon or a complementary apple. Mini-candy -> diced skewers and red-tart -> ordinary tart require recomputing the alternate brief, not simply adding 1.
scoring.customer_delta: Normally 0; optional -1/0/+1 for explicitly shown customer preference after onboarding. Avoid double-counting traits already scored in the order profile.
scoring.execution_penalty: 0 early with help; later 0-3 for visibly burnt, underdone or mishandled food. No hard fail or loss of apples during onboarding.

child_feedback.3: Best! Lovely apple choice and cooking.
child_feedback.1: OK! Try another apple or a small cooking change.
child_feedback.0: Not quite this time. Let us try a different recipe!

scoring.bad_fit_meaning: Bad fit for this specific brief, never a rotten apple, unsafe food claim, or insult to a variety.
scoring.blend_rule: Recompute weighted sweetness, tartness, juice and aroma by edible mass; track shape and color per component, not averaged. For the festival pie, judge three roles and execution separately. Single-apple matrix rows are component suitability only.
scoring.season_rule: A compressed in-game seasonal calendar; unlocks persist and stored apples remain available. Do not make children wait for real-world months.
scoring.rarity_rule: Delivery tiers and unlock order are authored pacing, not a claim to actual rarity; sourced commercial status is separate.
scoring.red_flesh_rule: Only four confirmed whole red/pink-flesh slots qualify by default. 4-23 can show red streaks near its skin but is not equivalent to a reliably red-fleshed cultivar.
